card.text: Giant planet found by GRAVITY where Gaia and radial velocities said a hidden companion must be.

sources.label: Hinkley et al. 2023
sources.quote: this effort is an early example of a direct imaging discovery of a bona fide exoplanet that was guided in part with Gaia astrometry

introduction.text: HD 206893 c is a giant planet circling about 3.5 au from its star, inside the orbit of B. Models in which it still burns deuterium fit its brightness best.

sources.label: Hinkley et al. 2023
sources.quote: theoretical atmospheric/evolutionary models incorporating deuterium burning for HD206893c

shape.title: Shape only
shape.summary: A sphere of the model radius, glowing with its own heat. No surface, colour or spin is measured.
